label: Patient C (synthetic)
facts: Diagnosis: non-small cell lung cancer, adenocarcinoma (non-squamous), stage IV.
EGFR L858R mutation detected on tissue sequencing at diagnosis.
First line: osimertinib for 14 months, stopped for progression.
Second line: carboplatin and pemetrexed for 4 cycles, then pemetrexed maintenance; progression after 7 months.
No prior immunotherapy and no prior antibody-drug conjugate.
Creatinine clearance 42 mL/min; other laboratory values within normal limits.
One untreated brain metastasis of 6 mm, asymptomatic.
History of grade 2 pneumonitis during prior treatment, resolved.
